items.title: Route anomaly `/user-public` — declared but not mounted, reproduced bug-for-bug
acceptance: GIVEN the application is running with the baseline route table
WHEN the browser navigates to /user-public
THEN the latent baseline behaviour is reproduced exactly: declared in the route table but never mounted; the project-switcher catch-all swallows it and treats "user-public" as a project id
AND no redirect, 404 page or new screen is introduced for this path

items.title: Query param `statuses` on /user-public/:tab
acceptance: GIVEN the application is at /user-public/:tab
WHEN the URL contains the statuses query parameter with a valid value
THEN the corresponding panel or view state is applied on cold load, without a full page reload
AND the same state change performed by interaction updates the URL parameter accordingly
AND a malformed value is rejected without crashing the screen
